lines.en: Listen, uh, can you do me a favor?
I got the PIN number to my ATM card.
Can you get it for me?
Uh, I scratched it on the ATM machine down on the corner.
Oh, do you want to talk to Chandler?
No, 'cause he didn't believe in my movie.
Which is a big mistake because it is real.
I've been trying to apologize to him all week.
If he's not going to let me do it on the phone,
I'm going to go down there.
I'm going to do it in person.
Uh, can you put him on?
and I want to prove that to you in person.
You haven't been taking my calls for a week.
Well, I'm totally over it, Chandler.
Would you mind doing a picture with us?
Okay, so, good talking to you,
